name: Kino
source:
Kino wants to destroy the vampire race. He is a naive, selfish prince who thinks that it’s natural that people do things for him. He is the typical egocentric prince who assumes that others will do what he asks. He is a person who does not hesitate to kill anyone who gets in the way. It is also shown that he hates being pitied or being called pitiful. Kino knows that to become Adam he must fall in love with Yui, so he does not mind conquering her in his "way." Kino has a personality very similar to that of Ayato.

Kino likes to play with his phone most of the time. He is fascinated by guava juice and hates sausages.

[spoiler]Kino is a creature, created via Rotigenberg miasma and something unknown Karlheinz left behind (actually Karlheinz's power), who mistakenly believes he is the Vampire King Karlheinz's illegitimate son.[/spoiler]
